model.summary: Model favors PIT by 5.3 points (70% win chance). Biggest factors: Quarterback rating (PIT +2.8), Elo rating (PIT +2.6), Rushing offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (PIT +1.7). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 48.8 total points (NO 22, PIT 27). Biggest factors: Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (lowers total 0.8), Natural grass field (raises total 0.7), Wind x pass rate (raises total 0.5). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
